title: Power to set and collect royalties
rule: A permit to harvest or extract forest produce from a forest reserve is granted on payment of royalties, at rates the Minister determines and prescribes.
points: This is the legal basis for the log-class royalty rates in the Royalties tab — the Act creates the power, the rate table itself (currently GN 132 of 2025) is set by regulation.

Factors the Minister must weigh in setting a royalty rate: the produce's potential market value; how accessible it is; the enterprise's profitability, taking expenses and capital investment into account; sustainability of the harvest; and other prescribed factors (s.78(2)).

No royalty is required for produce harvested within a village forest reserve or a community forest reserve, by a resident of the village or a member of the Group (as applicable) -- unless an agreement under which they manage the reserve specifically requires one (s.78(3)).
checks: Is it village- or community-forest-reserve own-use produce by a resident/Group member (royalty may not apply)
